title: Powers and three famous formulas
goal: Count factors to find N11 and N12, and see (a + b)² as a picture.
generalHint: Check each term. Count the factors. A square has a middle term with a factor 2.

mistakes.reply: There are two minus signs. What did you prove in lesson 1.3?

screens.label: PUZZLE
screens.title: A town that doubles
screens.prompt: A town has 50,000 people. The population doubles every 15 years. Do not calculate. Guess the population after 45 years.

options.reply: That adds 50,000 three times. Doubling multiplies the number by 2 each time. How many doublings are in 45 years?
That multiplies by 45. The population doubles every 15 years, not every year. How many 15−year periods are in 45 years?

feedback.correctWhy: 45 years have 3 periods of 15 years. 50,000 doubles 3 times: 400,000.

screens.caption: Pick one, then check.

screens.label: EXPLORE
screens.title: Double three times
screens.prompt: Tap to double the population. Each step multiplies by 2. After 3 steps, find the population.

mistakes.reply: That adds 3 · 50,000. Doubling multiplies by 2 each time. Try 50,000 · 2 · 2 · 2.
That is 6 · 50,000. 2³ means 2 · 2 · 2, which is not 2 · 3. What is 2 · 2 · 2?

hints: Multiply 50,000 by 2. Then multiply the result by 2. Do this 3 times.
screens.caption: Double 3 times, then check.

screens.label: NAME IT
screens.title: Powers
screens.prompt: $a^n$ means the product of $n$ factors $a$. Count the factors to see N11 and N12. Lang also writes $(ab)^n = a^n b^n$.

note.label: COUNT THE FACTORS
note.text: a² · a³ = (aa)(aaa) = aaaaa = a⁵. The exponents add, 2 + 3 = 5.

screens.label: EXPLORE
screens.title: A square with two strips
screens.prompt: Drag the split. The big square has side a + b. Find the total area of the four parts for a = 3 and b = 2.

answer.correctWhy: The four parts add to 25. This is the area of the square with side 3 + 2 = 5.

mistakes.reply: That adds only a² and b². The picture also has two strips. Add all four areas.
That adds only one strip. The picture has two strips of area 6. Add all four areas.

hints: Add the four areas in the picture.
screens.caption: Drag the split, then check.

screens.label: PROVE IT
screens.title: The square of a sum
screens.prompt: Prove that $(a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2$. Use only the rules for products. Give the reason for each step.

steps.label: write the square as a product

wrongReasonReplies.distrib: Distributivity splits a(b + c) into ab + ac. Is there a sum in brackets to multiply from the left?
wrongReasonReplies.distrib-right: This rule splits (b + c)a into ba + ca. Is there a sum in brackets to multiply from the right?
wrongReasonReplies.comm-mul: Commutativity changes the order of two factors. Which product changed order in this line?
wrongReasonReplies.N2: N2 turns a number plus its minus into 0. Is there a term and its minus here?
wrongReasonReplies.assoc-mul: Associativity changes the brackets in a product of three factors. Is there such a product here?
wrongReasonReplies.sq-def: This step writes a power as a product, or a product as a power. Is there a square to write out?
wrongReasonReplies.combine: This step adds two equal terms into one term. Are there two equal terms in the line before?

feedback.correctWhy: You used distributivity two times. The terms ab and ba are equal, so they make 2ab.

screens.caption: Tap a rule to fill the orange slot.

screens.label: PROVE IT
screens.title: The square of a difference
screens.prompt: Now prove $(a - b)^2 = a^2 - 2ab + b^2$. The steps are almost the same.

steps.label: write the square as a product

wrongReasonReplies.distrib: Distributivity splits a(b + c) into ab + ac. Is there a sum in brackets to multiply from the left?
wrongReasonReplies.distrib-right: This rule splits (b + c)a into ba + ca. Is there a sum in brackets to multiply from the right?
wrongReasonReplies.comm-mul: Commutativity changes the order of two factors. Which product changed order in this line?
wrongReasonReplies.N2: N2 turns a number plus its minus into 0. Is there a term and its minus here?
wrongReasonReplies.assoc-mul: Associativity changes the brackets in a product of three factors. Is there such a product here?
wrongReasonReplies.sq-def: This step writes a power as a product, or a product as a power. Is there a square to write out?
wrongReasonReplies.combine: This step adds two equal terms into one term. Are there two equal terms in the line before?

feedback.correctWhy: The middle term is −2ab. The two minus signs in −ab − ab do not cancel.

screens.caption: Tap a rule to fill the orange slot.

screens.label: PROVE IT
screens.title: A sum times a difference
screens.prompt: Last, prove $(a + b)(a - b) = a^2 - b^2$. Find out why the middle terms cancel.

steps.label: write the square as a product

wrongReasonReplies.distrib: Distributivity splits a(b + c) into ab + ac. Is there a sum in brackets to multiply from the left?
wrongReasonReplies.distrib-right: This rule splits (b + c)a into ba + ca. Is there a sum in brackets to multiply from the right?
wrongReasonReplies.comm-mul: Commutativity changes the order of two factors. Which product changed order in this line?
wrongReasonReplies.N2: N2 turns a number plus its minus into 0. Is there a term and its minus here?
wrongReasonReplies.assoc-mul: Associativity changes the brackets in a product of three factors. Is there such a product here?
wrongReasonReplies.sq-def: This step writes a power as a product, or a product as a power. Is there a square to write out?
wrongReasonReplies.combine: This step adds two equal terms into one term. Are there two equal terms in the line before?

feedback.correctWhy: The terms −ab and +ab add to 0 by N2. So only a² − b² is left.

screens.label: PRACTICE · 1 OF 5
screens.title: Multiply powers

mistakes.reply: Count the 2s: three, then four more. What is the total?
That is 8 · 7. Use N11: the exponents add. What is 2⁷?

hints: N11: add the exponents. Then find the value.

screens.label: PRACTICE · 2 OF 5
screens.title: Square a sum

options.label: $x^2 + 16$
options.reply: You have the two squares. The picture also has two strips, each with an area of 4x.

options.label: $x^2 + 4x + 16$
options.reply: There are two strips, and each has an area of 4x. How many 4x are in the middle term?

hints: Use (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² with a = x and b = 4.

steps.text: Use the formula for the square of a sum.

options.label: $x^2 + 25$
options.reply: You have the two squares. The picture also has two strips, each with an area of 5x.

options.label: $x^2 + 5x + 25$
options.reply: There are two strips, and each has an area of 5x. How many 5x are in the middle term?

screens.label: PRACTICE · 3 OF 5
screens.title: Square a difference

options.label: $4x^2 + 12x + 9$
options.reply: The middle term is 2 · (2x) · (−3). What sign does this term have?

options.label: $2x^2 - 12x + 9$
options.reply: The first term is (2x)². What is (2x)(2x)?

hints: Use (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² with a = 2x and b = 3.
The middle term is 2 · (2x) · 3 with a minus sign.

steps.text: Use the formula for the square of a difference.

options.label: $9x^2 + 12x + 4$
options.reply: The middle term is 2 · (3x) · (−2). What sign does this term have?

options.label: $3x^2 - 12x + 4$
options.reply: The first term is (3x)². What is (3x)(3x)?

screens.label: PRACTICE · 4 OF 5
screens.title: Sum times difference

options.label: $25 + y^2$
options.reply: The last term is y · (−y). What sign does it have?

options.label: $25 - 10y - y^2$
options.reply: The middle terms 5(−y) and 5y cancel. What is −5y + 5y?

feedback.correctWhy: The middle terms cancel. 5² = 25 and y · (−y) = −y².

hints: Use (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b² with a = 5 and b = y.

options.label: $36 + y^2$
options.reply: The last term is y · (−y). What sign does it have?

options.label: $36 - 12y - y^2$
options.reply: The middle terms 6(−y) and 6y cancel. What is −6y + 6y?

feedback.correctWhy: The middle terms cancel. 6² = 36 and y · (−y) = −y².

screens.label: PRACTICE · 5 OF 5
screens.title: Three factors
screens.prompt: Expand $(x + 1)(x - 2)(x + 3)$. Multiply the first two factors first.

options.label: $x^3 + 4x^2 + x - 6$
options.reply: Check (x + 1)(x − 2) first. The middle term is −2x + x. What is it?

options.label: $x^3 + 2x^2 - 5x + 6$
options.reply: The last term is 1 · (−2) · 3. What sign does it have?

hints: (x + 1)(x − 2) = x² − x − 2. Now multiply this by (x + 3).

options.label: $x^3 + 7x^2 + 2x - 8$
options.reply: Check (x + 2)(x − 1) first. The middle term is −x + 2x. What is it?

options.label: $x^3 + 5x^2 + 2x + 8$
options.reply: The last term is 2 · (−1) · 4. What sign does it have?

screens.label: LESSON 1.4 COMPLETE
screens.title: Say the formulas aloud.
screens.prompt: Lang says: read the three formulas aloud and repeat them like a poem.

trap.question: True or false: (a + b)² = a² + b².

options.label: True
options.reply: The picture has two strips as well as the two squares. Each strip has an area of ab. What is the full sum?

feedback.correctWhy: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b². The two strips give the middle term 2ab.

screens.caption: Saved to your rule book.
